# RAG Web Browser

The Apify actor [`apify/rag-web-browser`](https://apify.com/apify/rag-web-browser) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **1.0.33**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Web search and fetch tool for AI agents and RAG pipelines. It queries Google Search, scrapes the top N pages using a full web browser, and returns their content as clean Markdown for further processing by an LLM. Can also fetch individual URLs.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Fetched page $0.00228, Search result $0.00348, Actor Start $0.000225 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/rag-web-browser) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-rag-web-browser@1.0.33#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      query: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

The keywords might include the [advanced search operators](https://blog.apify.com/how-to-scrape-google-like-a-pro/). Examples: - san francisco weather - https://www.cnn.com - function calling site:openai.com |
| `maxResults` | integer |  | `3` | Maximum results — The maximum number of top organic Google Search results whose web pages will be extracted. If `query` is a URL, then this field is ignored and the Actor only fetches the specific web page. |
| `outputFormats` | string[] |  | `["markdown"]` | Output formats — Select one or more formats to which the target web pages will be extracted and saved in the resulting dataset. |
| `requestTimeoutSecs` | integer |  | `40` | Request timeout — The maximum time in seconds available for the request, including querying Google Search and scraping the target web pages. | `serpMaxRetries` | integer |  | `2` | SERP max retries — The maximum number of times the Actor will retry fetching the Google Search results on error. If the last attempt fails, the entire request fails. |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object |  | `{"useApifyProxy":true}` | Proxy configuration — Apify Proxy configuration used for scraping the target web pages. |
| `scrapingTool` | string |  | `"raw-http"` | Select a scraping tool — Select a scraping tool for extracting the target web pages. The Browser tool is more powerful and can handle JavaScript heavy websites, while the Plain HTML tool can't handle JavaScript but is about two times faster. |

This is useful to skip irrelevant page content. The value must be a valid CSS selector as accepted by the `document.querySelectorA |
| `htmlTransformer` | string |  | `"none"` | HTML transformer — Specify how to transform the HTML to extract meaningful content without any extra fluff, like navigation or modals. The HTML transformation happens after removing and clicking the DOM elements. - **None** (default) - Only removes the HTML elements specified via 'Remove HTML elemen |
| `desiredConcurrency` | integer |  | `5` | Desired browsing concurrency — The desired number of web browsers running in parallel. The system automatically scales the number based on the CPU and memory usage. If the initial value is `0`, the Actor picks the number automatically based on the available memory. |
| `maxRequestRetries` | integer |  | `1` | Target page max retries — The maximum number of times the Actor will retry loading the target web page on error. If the last attempt fails, the page will be skipped in the results. |
| `dynamicContentWaitSecs` | integer |  | `10` | Target page dynamic content timeout — The maximum time in seconds to wait for dynamic page content to load. The Actor considers the web page as fully loaded once this time elapses or when the network becomes idle. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
